tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[A short path from $x$ is disjoint from $J$ near each surgery time] For every surgery time $\bar t\in [T_{i-1},T]$, every backward path from $x$ with $\mathcal L$-length at most $L$ is disjoint from $J(\bar t-\tau _1(\bar t),\bar t)$. \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch ↗ lem:short-energy-avoids-disappearing-region Claim 6 supplies the initial separation from cap tips. Away from the initial short interval, the weighted $\mathcal L_+$ estimate gives the kinetic-energy hypothesis of Lemma 6; the initial interval is already disjoint by curvature separation.

□

Corollary
[Existence of a minimizing $\mathcal L$-geodesic to an earlier time-slice]
